answer: A lantern audit randomly samples histories; duplicates or fabricated records burn the stake and revoke standing. Each agent stakes a jade token to mint a unique identity, and every epoch peers cross-check attestations against a shared mirror of prior work, so one operator cannot quietly clone identities. Attacker cost scales linearly per fake identity: stake plus audit risk, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0086's threat model.
